name: PartyLoot
description: Turn the party's looting of bodies and containers nearby on or off.
note: Needs Mantella Living World - Followers and Nether's Follower Framework. Turn off Mantella's own Follow, Unfollow, Wait and Loot. Only offered for followers. Acts on the whole party.

state.description: Looting, exactly one of: on, off.

prompt: If the player tells the party to loot the area or to stop looting, begin your response with '{key}:'
